title: Control Plane Skeleton: Issue Schema and Label Taxonomy
objective: Define and document a canonical issue contract that supports deterministic routing.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical issue schema is defined and documented for this repository.
Label taxonomy maps to routing intent and triage transitions.
A sample issue validates against the schema and resolves to one routing target.

focus: Schema validation succeeds for required fields.
Routing target derives from triage label and execution lane.
Only canonical triage labels are accepted.
